title: Anuj Singh v. Managing Director, U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. & Ors.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Lucknow Bench)
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J. and Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, J.
disposition: Writ disposed with liberty to apply under Clause 6.5.
headnote: Billing dispute. Mandamus to correct an electricity bill and decide a representation not granted on merits. Petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if the application is made within a week, the authority is to hear and decide it expeditiously.
facts: Anuj Singh petitioned the Lucknow Bench for a mandamus directing U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and its officers to correct his electricity bill so that he could deposit it and apply for permanent disconnection, and a further mandamus to decide his representation dated 27 August 2025 by a speaking order. The Court treated the cause as a billing dispute and did not examine the bill or the representation on merits.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking correction of an electricity bill and decision of a billing representation is a billing dispute. The petitioner is to apply under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if such application is made within a week, the concerned authority shall hear and decide it expeditiously.

not_decided.issue: Whether the electricity bill required correction.
Whether permanent disconnection should follow deposit of the corrected bill.
Merits of the representation dated 27 August 2025.
